limitations: Same-device native eager events include scheduling and contention on the two streams. Seeded activations and layer-0 checkpoint weights. All normal and stress output words compared for both proposed paths.

Transport each shape-specific paired shift to both DP groups as applicable, cap positive credit by the shortest observed post-to-score span in that group. Keep the rest of each schedule fixed. Sample extremes are sensitivity cases, not confidence limits.

FFNPost reads coefficients after experts, and the subsequent boundary uses FFN pre. Archived slack omits any change in expert execution, shared/routed launch and inter-rank competition. Missing exactness means stock fallback. Only the archived eight requests and four eager batches are priced.
Changing Sinkhorn to one iteration measures a differential and changes the combination coefficients. It is not a candidate.

verdict: 在 171 的同一服务进程内，两轮诊断对自然输入检查了 10,390,732,800 个 BF16 字，每个字均一致。三轮候选计时中，在 256–1024 行的记录范围命中 600/600 次卡组层调用，系数任务均在真实路由分数就绪后提交。P90 首 token前参照、候选、后参照的中位数依次为 1.285、1.251、1.220 秒，相对前后参照分别快 2.65%、慢 2.57%。8 请求整轮前参照、候选、后参照的中位数依次为 15.808、15.766、15.804 秒，相对前后参照分别快 0.27%、快 0.24%。两项均未通过冻结门槛。11 轮共 88 个输出文本和负载计数吻合。原服务已恢复并通过生成验证。
